facts.fact: A third-party research report (Research and Markets) projects the retail media networks market to grow to $31.7 billion by 2028, as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: the retail media networks market is projected to grow to [$31.7 billion by 2028]

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog gives an example of a large retailer that works with around 14,000 suppliers, with its retail media network primarily focused on the top 10% of them.
facts.quote: a large retailer works with around 14,000 suppliers, but its retail media network primarily focuses on the top 10%

facts.fact: In the same example, the remaining smaller suppliers outside the top 10% of a retailer's roughly 14,000 suppliers number about 13,000, with limited access to advertising opportunities.
facts.quote: This leaves 13,000 smaller suppliers with limited access to advertising opportunities

facts.fact: The author states that when at Walmart Connect, the network initially focused on the top 10% of advertisers and it took years to expand beyond this group.
facts.quote: When I was at Walmart Connect, we initially focused on the top 10% of advertisers.
